label: suspect

unstated.what: Directories must load only *.conf files, ignoring files with other suffixes (e.g. file2.conf.disabled)

instruction_covers: --config accepting a directory and loading config snippets from it
later-overrides-earlier precedence when mixing directories and files
reason: The directory-loading behaviour is stated, but the hidden test additionally requires that only files ending in .conf are picked up (a .conf.disabled file is ignored). That filtering rule is only weakly implied by the word 'snippets', so a careful engineer might miss it, though it is guessable.
